label: claim the bounds of
notes: The First Article: all ground below the old shoreline bearing salt to the depth of a man's arm. Within the bounds the Wardenry answers for the crossings; beyond them it answers for nothing. The Third makes every well theirs to open, close and ration. Two centuries of self-chartered, competent administration, and nobody has thought to test where the claim stops until water turns up under the middle of it.
